name: cohort-signup
title: Cohort signup
description: The next intake of a course or programme: start date, length, price, seats left and an enrol button, with the application deadline.
docs: Pass the cohort (name, startsAt, weeks, schedule, price, seatsTotal, seatsTaken and deadline, and optionally priceNote, what the price is for), an action and the currency, locale and timeZone it is written in. startsAt and deadline are ISO times with an offset or a Z. Every date is written in the time zone you pass, and the first session's time and the deadline name that zone (CET, EST), so a reader elsewhere knows which moment is meant. The price is the biggest number in the enrolment panel. The seats are a bar with the count in words (14 of 30 left); at or below lowSeats the count turns heavy and says Only. When the seats run out the card says Full in text, the button becomes Join the waiting list (onClick is told which it was: reserve or waitlist) and a line says how the reader will be told. Once the deadline has passed the button closes and the card says Applications closed. That is judged on the reader's clock after the page has mounted, so the server never claims it and a page built ahead of time cannot go stale; pass now, the same on the server and in the browser, to pin the moment for a test or a screenshot. The action is a link when it has an href and a button when it has not, and syllabusHref adds a quiet link under it. On a wide section the facts sit beside the enrolment panel; on a narrow one they stack. The only client JavaScript is that clock; a function passed to it must come from a client component. labels translates every fixed word.
